invariants: Secondary Progressions uses the explicit day-for-year mapping: ageYears maps to natalJdTt + ageYears ephemeris days.
Secondary Progressions uses only the supplied versioned EphemerisProvider and rejects duplicate bodies, coverage violations and returned body/TT/provenance mismatches.
Solar Arc is derived from the actual secondary-progressed Sun longitude relative to the natal Sun, then the same normalized arc is applied to every natal placement.
Solar Arc requires natal source/dataVersion provenance to match the supplied ephemeris and does not substitute a fixed mean solar arc.
Annual Profections activates house one at age zero, advances one house/sign per integer year, and repeats modulo twelve from the natal Ascendant sign.
All three techniques are deterministic from caller-supplied birth/age inputs; device current time and network fallback are forbidden.
